basics.name: Haobo (Louie) Zhang
basics.label: Software Engineer & AI/ML Researcher
basics.summary: Computer Science graduate student with expertise in full-stack development, distributed systems, and AI/ML. Experienced in building scalable enterprise applications and conducting cutting-edge research in autonomous driving systems.

work.name: Healthy Claws
work.summary: Developed enterprise order management platform with microservices architecture, optimized database performance, and built CI/CD pipelines.
highlights: Developed enterprise order management platform with microservices architecture using Spring Cloud and Eureka
Optimized MySQL query performance, reducing response time from 2.5s to 112ms through index optimization
Implemented JWT-based authentication and authorization with Spring Security
Built CI/CD pipeline with Docker, AWS, and Jenkins, reducing deployment cycles

work.name: Changjia Fengxing Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd
work.summary: Conducted cutting-edge research in autonomous driving systems, developing 3D object detection models and multi-modal perception systems.
highlights: Developed vehicle-infrastructure cooperative 3D object detection model, achieving 2.5% improvement in 3D AP and BEV AP
Built multi-modal collaborative perception system integrating camera and LiDAR data with 8% performance improvement
Contributed to research published in NeurIPS 2023
Collaborated with scientists and domain experts to shape future research directions

work.name: Edith-Min International Inc.
work.summary: Analyzed business requirements and designed information systems solutions to optimize operational efficiency.
highlights: Turned query analytics into performance wins by redesigning indexes and access patterns
Defined logical and physical service architecture for large information systems
Partnered with vendors to design operational databases and established SAP EDI integrations
Built data pipelines for demand clustering and forecasting on 200k+ orders using K-Means and ARIMA

projects.name: YVR-Voyage-Watch
projects.summary: Mobile application using React Native with YOLOv8 and OpenCV for real-time object detection, optimized with TensorRT for sub-55ms processing time per frame.
highlights: Developed mobile app with React Native for real-time object detection
Optimized YOLOv8 model with TensorRT and quantization for <55ms processing time
Accelerated video processing using CUDA supporting 10 parallel streams
Integrated Firebase Firestore and Storage with offline persistence

projects.name: Scalable Distributed Ski Data System
projects.summary: Built distributed cloud system with Java and AWS EC2, scaling from 1M to 5M ski lift data records through JVM optimization and Redis caching strategy.
highlights: Designed and built distributed cloud system with Java and AWS EC2
Optimized JVM memory management to eliminate memory bottlenecks
Implemented Redis caching with LRU strategy, reducing query latency from 200ms to 50ms
Conducted high-concurrency stress testing with JMeter simulating 4,000 requests per second
